# maquette

- purpose: Kit-based low-poly 3D asset forge with dual GUI (`maquette`) and headless CLI (`maquette-cli`) frontends sharing a window-free core library
- version: 0.1.1
- language: Rust (edition 2021)
- binaries: `maquette` (requires `gui` feature, default), `maquette-cli` (no GUI deps required)
- features: `default = ["gui"]`, `gui` (enables `bevy_egui`, `bevy_panorbit_camera`, `bevy_infinite_grid`, `bevy_mod_outline`, `rfd`)
- engine: bevy 0.18, bevy_egui 0.39, bevy_panorbit_camera 0.34, bevy_infinite_grid 0.18, bevy_mod_outline 0.12

## Build & Test

- GUI + CLI: `cd maquette && cargo build --release`
- Headless CLI only: `cd maquette && cargo build --no-default-features --bin maquette-cli --release`
- Headless tests: `cd maquette && cargo test --no-default-features`

## `maquette-cli` Commands (`rlit_cli` contract: global `--json` envelope, `__schema`, exit codes 0-4)

- `export <input.maq> -o <out.glb|gltf> [--format glb|gltf] [--no-outline] [--outline-width 2.5] [--outline-color #000000]`
- `info <input.maq>`
- `validate <input.maq>`
- `render <input.maq> -o <out.png> [--width 512] [--height 512] [--background #181a1e] [--ambient 0.35]`
- `palette export <input.maq> -o <colors.json>`
- `palette import <input.maq> --from <colors.json> -o <out.maq>`
- `texture gen --prompt <text> -o <out.png> [--provider mock|rustyme] [--seed 0] [--width 128] [--height 128] [--no-cache]`
- `texture revoke <task_id> [--admin-url <url>]`
- `texture purge <queue> [--admin-url <url>]`
- `block list [--source local|hfrog|all]`
- `block get <id> [--source local|hfrog|all]`
- `block sync [--base-url <url>] [--runtime maquette-block/v1]`

## Module Layout

- core_lib (`src/lib.rs`, window-free): `grid`, `mesher`, `project`, `export`, `render`, `palette_io`, `texture_meta`, `texgen`, `block_meta`
- cli_bin: `src/bin/maquette_cli.rs`
- gui_bin (`src/main.rs`): `ui`, `camera`, `scene`, `block_library`, `block_composer`, `preview_mesh`, `multiview`, `export_dialog`, `slot_texgen`, `texture_registry`, `toon`, `history`, `autosave`, `session`, `float_window`, `notify`, `cloud_status`, `fonts`

## Env Vars

- `MAQUETTE_HFROG_BASE_URL` (default `https://hfrog.gamesci-lite.com`)
- `MAQUETTE_HFROG_RUNTIME` (default `maquette-block/v1`)
- `MAQUETTE_RUSTYME_REDIS_URL`, `MAQUETTE_RUSTYME_ADMIN_URL`
